summary: This Makefile snippet conditionally sets a CMD variable based on the APP_ENV environment variable. If we're in production, CMD stays empty (commands run directly), but in other environments like development, CMD becomes a docker compose prefix so commands run inside a container.

explanations.1: ifeq checks if two values are equal — here it's testing whether APP_ENV variable equals the string 'production'
explanations.2: CMD:= assigns an empty value to the CMD variable, meaning no prefix will be added to commands
explanations.4: CMD:= assigns a docker compose command as a prefix, so any command using $(CMD) will execute inside the specified container
